cases.sentence: Я не жил в доме с того дня, как вывел израильтян из Египта, и до ___, но переходил с места на место, обитая в шатре.
cases.explain: «сегодняшнего дня» — after the preposition «до», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: For I have not lived in a house since the day that I brought the children of Israel up out of Egypt, even to this day, but have moved around in a tent and in a tabernacle.

cases.sentence: Я уподоблю твое имя именам ___ земли.
cases.explain: «великих людей» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: I have been with you wherever you went, and have cut off all your enemies from before you. I will make you a great name, like the name of the great ones who are in the earth.

cases.sentence: И кто подобен Израилю, ___ на земле, который Бог выкупил Себе, чтобы сделать Своим народом?
cases.explain: «единственному народу» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: What one nation in the earth is like your people, even like Israel, whom God went to redeem to himself for a people, and to make himself a name, and to do great things for you, and awesome things for your land, before your people, whom you redeemed to yourself out of Egypt, from the nations and their gods?

cases.sentence: Ты сделал Израиль Своим ___ навеки, и Ты, Господи, стал его Богом.
cases.explain: «собственным народом» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: You established for yourself your people Israel to be your people forever; and you, Yahweh, became their God.
